objective: Implement a correct and fast general CUDA kernel for fmha_mxfp8_qkv on the complete public shape domain. Exact evaluator cases are private; every specialization decision must come from runtime properties or declared public parameters.

evaluation.performance_requirement: performance is measured across hidden cases after correctness passes

operator_contract.name: fmha_mxfp8_qkv
operator_contract.entrypoint: Model.forward(self, q_tensor, k_tensor, v_tensor, o_tensor, lse_tensor=None, sinks=None, seq_q_lens=None, seq_kv_lens=None, scale_softmax=None, current_stream=None, sf_q=None, sf_k=None, sf_v=None, amax_o=None, descale_q=None, descale_k=None, descale_v=None, scale_o=None, workspace=None, block_table=None, block_table_v=None, gate=None, sf_o=None)
operator_contract.semantics: Decode MXFP8 Q, K and V tensors and their block scales, compute masked scaled attention with the reference probability quantization and accumulation semantics, write the BF16 output, and write FP32 LSE when requested.

authoritative_public_sources.reference.py: exact operator computation, mutation and return semantics
authoritative_public_sources.input.py: runtime argument construction, dtypes, tensor layouts and value generation
authoritative_public_sources.shape_domain: verbatim projection of the benchmark shape_range.json, including complete public parameter ranges and cross-field constraints
